title: Overlay for Tier List
description: A clean, performant in-game overlay for Slay the Spire 2 displaying card, relic, and Ancient choice tier badges, scores, and evaluations.
changeNote: v1.1.0: In-game settings panel in the Mods screen (author switch, force refresh, per-feature toggles). New: potion badges, hover commentary, combat attack summary, live deck tracker, merchant gold-left, event commentary, reward badges. Refreshed tier data. Smaller package. Packaging cleanup: removed deps.json, which the game logged as an invalid manifest on 0.107.
